nodes.label: recipes Specification
nodes.description: Main OpenSpec spec for the recipes capability (created by archiving build-cooking-hub)

nodes.label: Recipe fields and validation (recipes)
nodes.description: A recipe SHALL have a title (required, not blank), description, hero image, source URL, servings (integer, default 2, at least 1), prep and cook minutes (whole numbers ≥ 0 or empty), tags, ingredient sections, step sections, notes (Markdown) and a favourite flag. scenarios: Recipe saved with all fields

Servings below 1 are rejected in the form
New recipe defaults to 2 servings

nodes.label: Manual creation form (recipes)
nodes.description: Recipes → "Add recipe" → "Start from scratch" SHALL open an empty form at `/recipes/new/form`. Ingredients and steps SHALL be entered as sections, each with an optional title ("For the sauce") and lines; a section with no lines SHALL be dropped on save. Save SHALL store the recipe and open its page `/recipes/<id>`. Leaving the form with unsaved changes SHALL ask "Discard changes?" with "Keep editi
scenarios: Recipe created from scratch
Empty section is dropped on save
Leaving with unsaved changes asks first
Leaving without changes does not ask

nodes.label: Markdown notes and steps (recipes)
nodes.description: Notes and step lines SHALL be Markdown, rendered with raw HTML disabled: HTML in the source SHALL appear as text, no script or event handler from it SHALL run, and only `http`, `https` and `mailto` links SHALL become links.
scenarios: Notes render Markdown
Unsafe link schemes stay text
Script in notes is not executed

nodes.label: Recipe images (recipes)
nodes.description: A recipe image SHALL come from an uploaded file or an image URL and SHALL be stored downscaled (long side at most 1600 px, at most 200 KB) as a BLOB in the `images` table, served at `GET /images/<id>` with `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`. nodes.label: Edit and delete (recipes)
nodes.description: Recipe → Edit SHALL open `/recipes/<id>/edit` with the form prefilled; Save SHALL update the recipe.
